approval: User approved preferred treatments in OPEN-ROADBLOCKS.md. This workpaper implements an explicit partial reconciliation without claiming missing source components have been resolved.
original_issue: Historical cash measures start with reported CFO, which adds back noncash stock compensation. Forward EBIT keeps compensation expensed and has different tax, working-capital, noncash and investment scopes. Joining them as one comparable valuation series would be misleading.
applied_treatment: For each of15annualperiods, preserve reported CFO and separately reverse exactly the SBC add-back in that same cash-flow statement, verified against the retained primary and extracted instance. Store the result as a diagnostic component of a future bridge, not as a replacement FCFF, FCFE, actual cash payment or fully valuation-aligned CFO.
source_selection: Exact approved annual cash-flow table from each issuer source-map; duration, CIK, consolidated dimensions, USD units, caption, context, primary XML ID, extracted-instance value and original source SHA256 are retained. The observed add-back is used, not the separately reported total SBC expense or a guessed cash/dilution figure.

before_after.new_partial_diagnostic: reported CFO minus reported SBC add-back once

alphabet_specific_scope: Total reported SBC expense differs from the cash-statement add-back. FY2025 total expense is rounded27.1B while the CFO add-back is24.953B. Their2.147B arithmetic difference is not an independently classified cash payment, liability or extra adjustment. Awards expected to settle in Alphabet stock and other awards can differ in economic/accounting treatment; do not subtract the total expense again or force a balancing plug.
remaining_roadblocks: Reported cash taxes, SBC tax benefits and tax accruals differ from forward normalized operating taxes; a full unlevered tax bridge is not established.
Nonoperating income/cash and other noncash expense populations need issuer-specific reconciliation.
Operating working-capital versus tax/noncurrent/acquisition/financing movements remains incomplete.
Cash purchases, new financed assets, lease prepayments/principal, capitalized-interest cash and creditor timing have different investment/financing scope.
Unknown financing and parent/minority attribution remain independent FCFE limitations.
Outstanding awards and shareholder dilution are separate from retaining a future compensation expense. Do not duplicate either charge.
forecasts_and_reporting: No cross-basis CAGR or automatic calibration to this diagnostic is permitted. Fully valuation-aligned CFO/FCFF/FCFE remain null. All15partial bridges retain an OPEN status and explicit limitations.
